𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝗦𝗘𝗔𝗟𝗘𝗗! 🇮🇳

Harmanpreet 126 (121) and Deepti 106* (86) power India Women to 328/6 🔥

Deepti adds 3 wickets, Vaishnavi takes 4/39 — win by 121 runs, 2-0 up 🏏

#Cricket #WomensCricket

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝗪𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗻 𝗻𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗷𝗲𝗲𝘁 𝗹𝗶! 🇮🇳🔥

Vadodara mein dusre ODI mein Zimbabwe ko 121 runs se haraya 🏏

👉 Harmanpreet Kaur – 126 (121 balls)
👉 Deepti Sharma – 106* (86 balls) + 3 wickets
👉 India 328/6, Zimbabwe 207 all out
👉 Vaishnavi Sharma – 4/39
